brand.tagline: Diagnose the constraint. Prioritize the next move.

bands.label: Critical Constraint
bands.message: Foundational gaps are likely suppressing performance. Focus on a small number of high-leverage corrections before adding complexity.

bands.label: Developing
bands.message: The organization has useful building blocks, but inconsistent alignment or discipline is limiting results.

bands.label: Advancing
bands.message: Core practices are working. The opportunity is to remove friction, increase visibility, and scale what is already producing value.

bands.label: FutureReady
bands.message: The organization has strong foundations. Focus on compounding advantages, faster learning loops, and scalable AI-enabled execution.

assessments.title: FutureReady Growth Architecture™ Scorecard
assessments.description: Grades strategy, revenue, operations, and AI alignment.

questions.text: Our leadership team has a clearly documented 12–24 month growth strategy.
Strategic priorities translate into measurable quarterly outcomes.
Leaders consistently agree on the top three enterprise priorities.
We know the primary constraints limiting revenue growth.
Our pipeline, conversion, retention, and expansion metrics are visible to leadership.
Sales and marketing operate from shared definitions and targets.
Critical initiatives have clear owners, deadlines, dependencies, and success measures.
Operational bottlenecks are identified and resolved systematically.
Leadership has reliable visibility into execution without excessive meetings.
AI initiatives are tied to business outcomes rather than experimentation alone.
We have prioritized workflows where AI can improve revenue, margin, speed, or customer experience.
AI governance, ownership, and adoption responsibilities are defined.

assessments.title: AI Adoption Readiness Optimizer
assessments.description: Scores readiness across business value, data, workflow, people, and governance.

questions.text: We have identified specific business outcomes AI should improve.
AI use cases are prioritized using value, feasibility, risk, and time-to-impact.
The data required for priority AI use cases is accessible and sufficiently reliable.
Core systems can integrate with AI tools through APIs, automation, or secure workflows.
Priority workflows are documented well enough to automate or augment.
We measure baseline cycle time, cost, quality, or conversion before implementing AI.
Executives and functional leaders understand where AI can and cannot create value.
Employees receive practical AI training relevant to their work.
There are accountable owners for adoption and change management.
Policies exist for privacy, security, human review, and acceptable AI use.
We have a process to evaluate AI vendors, models, and risks.
AI performance and business impact are reviewed after deployment.

assessments.title: Execution Gap Optimizer
assessments.description: Measures strategy-to-delivery friction and execution discipline.

questions.text: Teams can explain how their work connects to enterprise priorities.
Major initiatives have clear definitions of done and measurable outcomes.
Priority changes are communicated quickly and consistently.
Every critical initiative has one accountable executive owner.
Decision rights are explicit enough to prevent unnecessary escalation.
Cross-functional dependencies have named owners.
Operating reviews focus on decisions, blockers, and corrective actions.
Problems are surfaced early rather than near deadlines.
Teams close action items reliably between leadership meetings.
Leadership can see current status, risks, and business impact in one view.
KPIs are timely enough to support intervention before performance misses compound.
We distinguish activity metrics from true outcome metrics.

assessments.title: Revenue Leak Optimizer
assessments.description: Surfaces the highest-likelihood leakage points across acquisition, conversion, retention, and expansion.

questions.text: We can identify which channels produce qualified pipeline, not just leads.
Cost of acquisition is measured by segment or channel.
Lead response and follow-up standards are consistently met.
Pipeline stages have objective exit criteria.
We know conversion rates by stage and can explain major losses.
Sales cycle length and stalled opportunities are actively managed.
We know the leading indicators of churn or non-renewal.
Customer health and at-risk accounts are visible before renewal.
Post-sale handoffs preserve the expectations established during sales.
We systematically identify cross-sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities.
Customer value realization is measured and communicated.
Account plans identify executive relationships, risks, and growth paths.
